Coverage_Description: Lump-sum cancer protection: 100% sum insured for covered cancer; 25% for covered early cancer (carcinoma in situ/early thyroid or prostate), with early-claim amount reducing subsequent cancer benefit; HK$20,000/US$2,500 death benefit if no cancer claim paid
customer requirement: Health declaration required; no medical exam
price structure: Yearly renewable premium; rates can be adjusted at each policy anniversary by risk class (e.g., age, sex, smoking)
additional informations: Guaranteed renewal to age 81 (age next birthday); available as a standalone basic plan; policy currency HKD or USD
